facts.statement: Melitosaurus was discovered in 1850 in marine limestone in Gozo, Malta.
facts.quote: Melitosaurus is an extinct genus of gavialid crocodylian discovered in Gozo, Malta in Early Miocene Aquitanian stage marine limestone rock in 1850.

facts.statement: The genus Melitosaurus was named by Owen in 1850.
Melitosaurus is a member of the subfamily Tomistominae and is related to the living False gharial.
facts.quote: It is related to the extant (living) False gharial and a member of the same subfamily Tomistominae

facts.statement: Melitosaurus belongs to the family Gavialidae.
Melitosaurus lived during the Early Miocene Aquitanian stage.
facts.quote: Melitosaurus is an extinct genus of gavialid crocodylian discovered in Gozo, Malta in Early Miocene Aquitanian stage marine limestone rock in 1850.

facts.statement: Melitosaurus lived between 20.45 and 15.98 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Burdigalian to Burdigalian (20.45 to 15.98 million years ago)
